resolved_findings.finding: Missing Anthropic cache usage could have defaulted to zero.
resolved_findings.resolution: account requires all four core usage counts explicitly, including read and write. Missing categories produce unknown usage; new tests retain the full reservation and prohibit redispatch.

resolved_findings.resolution: canonical_live_journal requires literal /results and /workspace; shared Dispatcher enforces that canonical journal for nonfixture AM1, even when called without the first_block wrapper. New test rejects alternate root before calls.

resolved_findings.finding: Installed runtime pins were checked only during preparation/mock.
resolved_findings.resolution: runtime_guard verifies Linux, Python3.12.15, declared pinned image ID, and installed Anthropic1.4.0/OpenAI1.107.0. first_block invokes it and canonical nonfixture Dispatcher validation invokes it. New test rejects changed SDK metadata.

resolved_findings.finding: Known ChatCompletions text/image detail fields would have been unnecessarily rejected.
resolved_findings.resolution: Normalization now accepts bounded text breakdowns and zero image/audio details, preserves core write/read requirements, and rejects invalid/nonzero unsupported modality counts. Tests exercise both valid and invalid forms.

public_payg_and_account_limitations: The financial envelope is a conservative operational inference from current published provider contracts, not a guarantee against provider misbilling.

A future explicit grant and preflight must bind the exact study/control/public-payg-envelope-v1 profile; unknown, private or unpriced capacity contracts remain unsupported. Matching the profile label is an operator attestation, not an account API verification.

Geographic surcharges are conservatively retained in applicable settled usage-based upper bounds, so ledger values need not equal invoices. No actual account, model entitlement, settings acceptance or real billing was verified.

The literal image environment value and container paths are local guards, not independent mount/image attestation. A separately authorized future provider-enabled launcher must inspect the actual pinned image and canonical host-to-/workspace,/results mappings and explicit-key boundary; it remains a future prerequisite.
